blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language models are already asked questions of Thai law.
Lawyers, students and the public ask which section applies to a set of facts, what the consequence is, and how a court would decide.
A benchmark that measures how well a model does this needs four things.
(1) It needs questions from real disputes, with the verdict and the reasoning a court gave.
(2) It needs the grading a Thai lawyer would apply, which scores the reasoning and not only the outcome.
(3) It needs the full statute book, so that a model can be tested as a retrieval agent and not only from memory.
And (4) it needs the version of each section that was in force when the case was decided, because the law changes and a court applies the law of its day.
blocks.zh:
语言模型已经被问到泰国法律的问题。
律师、学生和公众询问哪一节适用于一组事实,后果是什么,法院如何决定。
衡量一个模型如何完善的基准需要四样东西。
(1) 它需要从真正的争端中提出问题,并需要法院的判决和推理。
(2) 它需要泰国律师的分级,该分数是推理的,而不仅仅是结果。
(3)它需要完整的成文法书,这样一个模型就可以作为检索代理测试,而不仅仅是从内存中测试.
(4)它需要案件判决时生效的每一节的版本,因为法律有所改变,法院适用其当时的法律.

blocks.en:
No Thai legal benchmark has had the four together.
Our earlier benchmark, NitiBench [ 3 ] , asks questions written for the Civil and Commercial Code and the Revenue Code against a 2024 snapshot of the text, and two years later 2.3% of its citations are already outdated (§ 2 ).
Benchmarks for English and Chinese law treat the law as a fixed text as well [ 31 , 27 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh:
没有泰国的法律基准将这四个基准放在一起。
我们先前的基准Niti Bench[3]针对《民法典》和《税收法典》的2024年快照提出了问题,两年后,其引用的2.3%已经过时(第2节)。
英国和中国法律的基准也把法律视为固定文本[31、27、26]。

blocks.en:
NitiBench + , its sequel, has all of them.
The benchmark is temporal in one sense only. Every question carries the date of its case, and the answer is graded against the law in force on that date.
It holds 1,670 items and 4,071 sub-questions from decisions of three Thai courts, in 17 domains of law from family and succession to administrative contracts (§ 4 ).
Each item gives the fact pattern and asks for the verdict, the reasoning and the sections applied, and the gold answer is copied from the decision.
Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, from 0 to 10, which we call the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the sections the model cites and the sections the court relied on (§ 5 ).
Every gold citation is resolved to the version in force on the decision date and paired with the current text (Figure 1 ).
The retrieval corpus holds every version of every Thai statute section, 394,943 dated texts of 106,041 sections.

它在家庭和行政合同继承的17个法律领域(第4节)拥有1 670项和泰国三个法院裁决的4 071个分问题。

blocks.en: We built the benchmark for two purposes.
blocks.zh: 我们建立基准有两个目的。

blocks.en:
The first is to show that the version of the text matters, and to set up the task so that it does not distort the score.
Law is not a fixed text. Statutes are amended and repealed.
A question taken from a court decision has its answer in the text in force on that day, not in the current text.
Across 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts, the cited law has changed since the decision in up to 67% of the cases by court, and of the 1,031 Acts Parliament has passed since 2002, 55% amend or repeal an earlier one (§ 3 ).
Of 53 legal benchmarks from 19 jurisdictions, none grades the version of the law.
A benchmark that checks the section number but not the version rewards an answer drawn from the wrong text.
We ask what happens when a model reads the current text of a correct section, and whether searching the law in force on the decision date fixes the problem.
We ran two experiments on 13 open-weight models over the full benchmark.
First, we gave the model the correct citation and swapped the version, the text in force or the current text.
Second, we placed the model in a retrieval agent and changed its index from the current text to the text in force on the decision date.
Reading the current text of an amended section lowers the Bar-standard score by 0.25 points.
For questions on repealed sections, the current text contains no provision for the model to cite, and the score falls by 0.79 points.
Searching the law in force recovers part of these points for the models that search, and none for the models that do not (Part I, § 6 ).
The text in force is the fair setting for a question taken from a dated decision, and every result in Part II uses it.
blocks.zh:
第一种是显示文本版本的重要性,并设置任务,以免扭曲分数.
法律不是固定文本。 法规被修改和废止.
从法院裁决中取出的问题在当天生效的案文中,而不是在目前的案文中都有答案。
在泰国四个法院的156 650起裁决中,自法院裁决以来,上述法律发生了变化,多达67%的案件,自2002年以来,在1,031起法案中,议会通过了55%的法案修改或废除了先前的法案(第3节)。
在来自19个管辖区的53个法律基准中,没有一个对法律文本进行评级。
检查节号而不是版本的基准奖励从错误文本中得出的答案。
我们问,当一个模型读出当前正确一节的案文时会发生什么情况,在决定日期搜索现行法律是否解决问题。
我们运行了两个实验 13个开放重量模型 超过整个基准。
首先,我们给了模型正确的引用,并交换了版本,生效文本或当前文本.
第二,我们将该模型放入一个检索代理,并将其索引从目前的文本改为决定日期生效的文本。
读取修正一节的正文后,巴标准分数降低0.25分.
对于被废止部分的问题,目前的案文没有规定要引用模式,分数会下降0.79分.
搜索现行法律为搜索模型找回了部分这些分数,没有为搜索模型找回部分分数(第一部分,第6节)。
现行案文是从已过时的决定中抽取问题的公平框架,第二部分的每一项结果都使用它。

blocks.en:
The second is to measure today’s models on that setting.
Lawyers, students and the public already put legal questions to language models, and no measurement says how far the answers can be trusted.
We run a public leaderboard on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, 29 or 30 per domain, so that a new model can be added at a bounded cost, and we release a validation split of the same shape.
It ranks 26 models in three settings, from memory alone, with the court’s sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, and it reports the cost per item, the hallucinated citations and the score by domain.
The leaderboard then asks what limits the models, the knowledge of the statutes, the use of a search tool, or the application of the law to the facts, and what Thai and legal post-training adds to a base.
The leading model scores 7.78 out of 10 as a retrieval agent and the best open-weight model 6.39 (Part II, § 7 ).
blocks.zh:
第二是衡量当今的模型。
律师,学生和公众已经向语言模型提出了法律问题,没有衡量标准可以说明答案可以信任的程度.
我们运行一个公开的领跑板,在被搁置的测试分出500个按域分出,每个域分出29个或30个,这样就可以以限定的成本添加出一个新的模型,我们发布一个相同形状的验证分出.
它在三种情况下排名26个型号,从记忆中单独列出,由法院的科室提供,并作为一个对现行法律的检索代理,它逐项报告成本、幻觉引用和域分。
领导板接着问,对模型,法规的知识,搜索工具的使用,或者法律对事实的适用,以及泰国和法律后培训对一个基础有什么补充,是什么限制.
领先的型号作为回取剂得分为7.78分,最佳开放量级型号为6.39分(第二部分第7节).

blocks.en: This report makes three contributions. 1. A temporal benchmark. NitiBench + , 1,670 items from three courts in 17 domains, with every gold citation resolved to the version in force on the decision date and paired with the current text, and the full dated statute corpus to retrieve from. 2. The cost of the version. An audit of 156,650 Thai decisions, and the score 13 open-weight models lose when they read the current text instead of the text in force, by drift band and by the kind of change. The text in force is the fair setting. 3. A leaderboard and an analysis of today’s models. A public ranking of 26 models on a held-out 500-item test split in three settings, with citation precision and recall, hallucinated citations and the cost per item, and an analysis of what limits the models, in statute knowledge, tool use and the application of the law.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Legal QA benchmarks exist for English (LegalBench [ 31 ] , LexGLUE [ 17 ] , CaseHOLD [ 85 ] ), Chinese (LawBench [ 27 ] , LexEval [ 51 ] ), law-school examinations (LEXam [ 26 ] , KCL [ 62 ] ), retrieval (LegalBench-RAG [ 67 ] ), tool-using agents (LegalAgentBench [ 49 ] ), and Thai law (NitiBench [ 3 ] ).
Most of them score a multiple-choice answer or a retrieved passage, and none of them grades the version of the law (§ 3 ).
NitiBench + scores a free-form verdict and its reasoning on the rubric Thai bar examiners use, and the cited sections against the court’s own.

blocks.en:
NitiBench + is the sequel of NitiBench [ 3 ] , our earlier Thai legal QA benchmark, and it is built to measure a language model on Thai law in every aspect a Thai lawyer would ask of it.
NitiBench has a CCL split of 3,729 questions on the Civil and Commercial Code and a Tax split of 50 questions from Revenue Department rulings, each written against a 2024 snapshot of the statute text.
Two years later, 2.3% of its CCL citations no longer match the current text, and 25% of its cited sections have been amended at some point (§ 3 ).
NitiBench + widens every part of it. The questions come from decided cases of three courts across 17 domains instead of two codes. The answer is a free-form verdict with its reasoning, graded on the rubric Thai bar examiners use, with the cited sections checked against the court’s own. Every citation is resolved to the version in force on the decision date and paired with the current text, and the retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every section, so a model can be tested from memory, with the court’s sections, and as a retrieval agent. A public leaderboard keeps the measurement current as models are released.
On the model side, several Thai post-trainings of open bases have been released, among them Typhoon [ 66 ] , Pathumma [ 58 ] , THaLLE [ 44 ] , OpenThaiGPT [ 65 ] , SEA-LION [ 9 ] and OpenThai 2.0 Legal [ 39 ] .
Section 7.6 tests what they add to their bases on Thai law.

Niti Bench在《民法》和《商法》方面有3 729个问题,在税收部门的裁决中也有50个问题,每个问题都写在2024年法规文本的快照上。

blocks.en:
Several jurisdictions publish point-in-time statutes, including the UK, Australia, and Canada, and citation graphs exist across multiple legal systems [ 47 , 42 ] .
No single resource combines dated statute versions, dated court rulings with resolved citations, and an evaluation benchmark.
FourCorners [ 2 ] unifies all three for Thai law and supplies our corpus of dated statutes and rulings.
Recent studies of time in legal QA add dates to German statutory questions [ 69 ] , track versions of the French tax code [ 18 ] , and compare Chinese judgments before and after the 2021 Civil Code [ 36 ] .
Each relies on a task-specific dataset.
NitiBench + covers a national case-law corpus with the complete statute book in every version.

blocks.en: 3 How Much Law Drifts
blocks.zh: 3 多少法律漂流

blocks.en:
Using FourCorners [ 2 ] , we examine drift from three angles, how often court citations become outdated, what existing benchmarks record about time, and how often Parliament amends existing statutes rather than passing new ones.
To measure court drift, we compare the statute text in force on the decision date with the text current on 1 September 2026. A cited section has drifted if its text was amended or repealed between those two dates (Figure 1 ). We evaluated every decision with resolved citations across four courts: the Supreme Court (51,566 decisions since 1935), the Constitutional Court (2,025 rulings since 1998), the Administrative Courts (101,315 judgments since 2001), and the Court of Appeal for Specialised Cases (1,744 decisions since 2016).
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Table 1 categorizes each decision by its most severely drifted citation. Across all four courts, 79,394 of 156,650 decisions (50.7%) cite law that has changed. Specifically, cited law changed in 67.1% of Supreme Court decisions, 62.4% of Constitutional Court rulings, 42.6% of Administrative Court judgments, and 23.3% of specialised appeal court decisions. Each court drifts for different reasons
The Supreme Court relies on legal codes amended incrementally over decades.
The Constitutional Court cites constitutions replaced in 2007 and 2017 along with their organic acts.
The Administrative Courts cite general codes alongside repealed administrative laws (one in six judgments cites a repealed act, such as the 1992 Civil Service Act or the 1987 Expropriation Act).
The specialised appeal court cites commercial, labor, and family codes amended over the past decade.
This drift is not limited to older cases. As shown in Figure 2 , only Supreme Court decisions from the 2020s maintain over 80% alignment with current text. For cases from the 2010s, half had a cited section rewritten within five years.
blocks.zh:
表1将每项决定按最漂移的引文分类。 在所有四个法院中,156 650个裁决中有79 394个(50.7%)援引了已经改变的法律。 具体地说,援引的法律在67.1%的最高法院裁决、62.4%的宪法法院裁决、42.6%的行政法院裁决以及23.3%的专门上诉法院裁决中有所改变。 每个法庭都因不同的原因漂泊
最高法院依赖几十年来逐步修订的法典。
宪法法院援引了2007年和2017年被取代的宪法及其组织法。
行政法院在援引被废除的行政法的同时,还援引了一般法典(六项判决中有一项援引被废除的法律,如1992年《公务员法》或1987年《征用法》)。
专门上诉法院援引了过去十年来修正的商业、劳工和家庭法。
这种漂移并不限于更古老的案例. 如图2所示,只有最高法院从2020年代做出的裁决与现有案文保持一致80%以上。 对于2010年代的案件,半数在五年内重写了引文一节。

blocks.en:
We checked 53 legal benchmarks across 19 jurisdictions for what they record about time (Table 2 ).
Of the 53, 44 cite statutes in their gold answers, 10 give the date of every item, 9 carry a statute version, and none grades a model on the version. Every reported score therefore reflects the current law, even for a benchmark built from past court decisions.
Table 3 lists the 53 benchmarks. Each cell was read from the dataset’s schema, its data files or its paper on 5 October 2026. The audit file released with the code holds, for every cell, the field names or the quoted sentence it rests on and a confidence grade. Two rows are graded low confidence because only the paper was available. In total, 44 benchmarks cite statutes in their gold answers (20 fully), 10 give full item dates and 15 partial ones, 9 carry a statute version, 5 of them the concurrent temporal studies, and 10 state a snapshot date.

我们检查了19个管辖区的53个法律基准记录的时间(表2)。
在53个中,有44个在黄金答案中引用了法规,有10个给出了每件物品的日期,有9个带有法规版本,没有哪个等级是该版本的模型. 因此,每个报告的得分都反映了现行法律,即使是根据以往法院判决建立的基准也是如此。

blocks.en: Legislative records confirm this pattern. Since 2002, Parliament published 1,031 Acts in the Royal Gazette. Of these, 567 (55%) amended or repealed existing statutes rather than introducing new ones. This proportion rose from 53% in the 2000s to 65% in the 2020s. Over the same period, the executive issued 3,299 royal decrees and 4,440 ministerial regulations. Because most legislative activity updates existing law, static benchmarks based on snapshot statutes quickly fall out of sync.
blocks.zh: 立法记录证实了这一模式。 自2002年以来,议会在《皇家公报》上公布了1,031项法案。 其中,567项(55%)修正或废除了现有法规,而不是引入了新的法规。 这一比例从2000年代的53%上升到2020年代的65%。 在同一时期,行政部门发布了3,299项皇家法令和4,440项部长条例。 由于大多数立法活动都更新了现有法律,基于快照法规的静态基准很快就脱离同步.

blocks.en:
Without version tracking, benchmarks cannot detect when their gold answers expire (§ 2 ). We evaluated our own earlier benchmark, NitiBench [ 3 ] , whose questions include the statutory text used during annotation (Table 4 ):
NitiBench-CCL was built on 2024 statutes. Two years later, 2.3% of its citations are outdated, including Section 1435 of the Civil and Commercial Code (marriage age, amended by the 2025 marriage equality act). Over 25% of its cited sections have been amended previously, and errors will accumulate undetected.
To avoid drift, NitiBench-Tax sampled only post-2021 Revenue Department rulings that match the latest Revenue Code. While this preserved temporal accuracy, it shrank the benchmark to just 50 questions.
NitiBench + avoids this trade-off by preserving decision dates and indexing both historical and current texts.
blocks.zh:
没有版本跟踪,基准无法检测黄金答案何时到期(§2). 我们评价了我们先前的基准,Niti Bench[3],其中的问题包括在注释中使用的法定案文(表4):
Niti Bench-CCL建于2024年法规. 两年后,其引文中有2.3%已经过时,包括《民法》和《商法典》第1435条(结婚年龄,由《2025年婚姻平等法》修正)。 它引用的章节有25%以上以前已经修改过,错误会累积而未被发现.
为了避免漂移,尼蒂·本克-塔克斯在2021年后才取样 税务局的裁决符合最新的《税务法》。 虽然这保持了时间的准确性,但它把基准缩小到50个问题。
Niti Bench + 通过保留决定日期并索引历史文本和当前文本,避免了这种取舍.

blocks.en: 4 The NitiBench + Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 Niti Bench+基准

blocks.en:
NitiBench + consists of 1,670 items and 4,071 sub-questions spanning 17 Thai legal domains, sourced from three courts (Table 5 ).
The Supreme Court provides private, criminal, and regulatory domains (1,303 items).
The Constitutional Court provides public constitutional law (50 items).
The Supreme Administrative Court provides administrative domains covering official acts, state contracts, public liability, and personnel (317 items).
blocks.zh:
Niti Bench + 包括1 670个项目和4 071个分问题,涉及17个泰国法律领域,来自三个法院(表5)。
最高法院提供私人、刑事和监管领域(1 303项)。
宪法法院规定了公共宪法(50项)。
最高行政机构 法院提供行政领域,涵盖官方行为、国家合同、公共责任和人员(317项)。

blocks.en:
Domains reflect the core areas of each court’s reasoning. We preserved major fields, split standalone statutory areas (such as narcotics and traffic), and merged smaller categories. Each domain contains 56 to 146 items. Benchmark summary scores are equal-weighted macro-averages across domains.
Because judicial decisions do not follow question-answer formats, an extraction pipeline converts each decision into a fact pattern, sub-questions, and statutory provisions (§ 4.1 ). Gold verdicts and reasoning are preserved as verbatim excerpts from the decisions.
blocks.zh:
领域反映了每个法院推理的核心领域。 我们保留了主要领域,分割了单独的法定领域(如麻醉品和贩毒),并合并了较小的类别。 每个域包含56至146个项. 基准汇总分数是各领域相等加权的宏观平均数。
由于司法裁决不遵循问答格式,抽取管道将每项裁决转化为事实模式、分问题和法定条款(第4.1节)。 黄金判决和推理被保留为裁决的逐字节选.

blocks.zh: 表5:按漂移波段和问题类型分列的每个域的项目和分问题。 漂流波段是项目所依赖的引用中最严重的状态. 法院自己的问题是法院回答的问题。 其他四种类型的定义见第4.1节。

blocks.en: Each item contains one or more sub-questions with its own verdict, reasoning, and citations. Dependent sub-questions are flagged and answered sequentially. Gold citations are resolved via FourCorners [ 2 ] to the version active on the ruling date. Citations mentioned only for background context are kept in the record but ignored during scoring. Figure 1 illustrates an item with both texts for a drifted citation. Appendix A.1 contains the full schema and a worked item.
blocks.zh: 每个项目都包含一个或多个子问题,并附有自己的判决、推理和引用。 所依赖的子问题依次标出并回答. 黄金引用通过FourCorners[2]解决到裁决日活跃的版本. 仅针对背景背景的引用保留在记录中,但在打分时被忽略. 图1显示一个有两种文本的项目,用于漂移引用。 附录A.1载有整个计划和一个工作项目。

blocks.en: 4.1 Construction pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 建筑管道

blocks.en: The pipeline extracts facts, reasoning, and citations directly from the court’s decision.
blocks.zh: 该管道直接取自法院判决的事实、推理和引用。

blocks.en: Candidate decisions are stratified by decade and drift status. Claude Opus 5 screens candidates, keeping challenging cases where the court applies at least three substantive statutory provisions. Fact-only disputes and procedural rulings are excluded. Duplicate holdings are grouped so no question appears more than twice, maximizing question diversity.
blocks.zh: 候选人的决定按十年和漂移状况进行分级。 Claude Opus 5 筛选候选人,保留对法院适用至少三项实质性法定条款的案件提出质疑。 仅涉及事实的争端和程序性裁决不在此列。 重复的持有量被归为一类,因此问题不会出现两次以上,从而最大限度地增加问题的多样性。

blocks.en:
Claude Fable 5 generates structured records from selected decisions. Each record contains the fact pattern, decision date, sub-questions with corresponding verdicts and reasoning, and exact source spans. Citations are classified as either primary or background. In addition to direct judicial rulings, we create four targeted question types:
(1) Identifying governing provisions.
(2) Determining legal consequences.
(3) Interpreting interactions between multiple provisions.
(4) Identifying departures from lower court decisions.
All gold answers remain verbatim text spans. Table 5 provides full item counts.
blocks.zh:
Claude Fable 5从选定的决定中生成结构化记录. 每个记录都包含事实模式,决定日期,带有相应判决和推理的子问题,以及确切的来源跨度. 引用被归类为主要或背景. 除了直接的司法裁决外,我们创造了四种有针对性的问题类型:
(1) 确定管辖条款。
(2) 确定法律后果。
(3) 解释多个条款之间的相互作用。
(4) 查明偏离下级法院裁决的情况。
所有黄金答案仍然是逐字记录。 表5列出全部项目。

blocks.en:
Deterministic checks confirm that text spans match the source records and citations are well-formed. Citations are resolved to the version active on the ruling date; items with unresolvable primary citations are removed.
Citations to external materials like ministerial notifications remain unscored, and joined cases are consolidated.
Finally, human annotators review every item against the original ruling to verify legal accuracy.
blocks.zh:
决定性检查确认文本跨度与源记录相匹配,引用形式也很好. 引用解决到裁决日活跃的版本;删除无法解决的主引用的项目。
诸如部长级通知等外部材料的引用仍然没有记分,合并案件也得到合并。
最后,人类的注释者根据最初的裁决审查每个项目,以核实法律的准确性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Drift bands
blocks.zh: 4.2 漂流带

blocks.en:
Decisions span from 1949 to 2026. Items are assigned to one of three drift bands based on their most heavily altered citation: No-drift (Control): 487 items (29%) where cited statutes remain unchanged. Amended: 759 items (46%) where statutory text has been modified. Repealed: 424 items (25%) where the cited statute was subsequently repealed, or was already repealed at the time of the ruling (Appendix A.2 ).
Because a single changed citation shifts an entire item out of the control band, 71% of items exhibit drift even though 65% of individual citations remain current (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh:
决定从1949年到2026年。 物品根据最有改动的引号分配给三个漂移带中的一个: 无拖放(管制):487项(29%),所列章程保持不变。 修订:修改法定文本的759项(46%)。 被废除:424项(25%),其中引用的法规后来被废除,或在裁决时已经被废除(附录A.2.).
由于单次更改的引文会将整个物品从控制带中移出,71%的物品显示漂移,尽管65%的个人引文仍然流出(表5)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Current and In-force corpora
blocks.zh: 4.3 现职和在职人员

blocks.en:
The retrieval corpus indexes 394,943 texts across 106,041 sections in 5,912 laws. Each section includes effective dates and operational status as of 1 September 2026. Across all benchmark items, 9,223 citations reference 3,006 sections across 298 laws. Each citation includes both its in-force and modern text:
5,869 citations are unchanged between versions.
1,934 citations are amended text.
1,263 citations are repealed laws with no modern counterpart.
blocks.zh:
在5 912项法律的106 041个章节中,检索表索引为394 943个文本。 每节列出截至2026年9月1日的生效日期和运行状况. 在所有基准项目中,9 223个引用了298个法律中的3 006个章节。 每一引文包括其生效文本和现代文本:
5 869个引用版本之间没有变化。
1 934起引文为修正后的案文。
1,263起引用是废止的法律,没有现代对应法律。

blocks.en:
We evaluate models across two statutory corpora.
The Current corpus reflects statutory text on 1 September 2026, matching traditional benchmark setups.
The In-force corpus reflects the statutory text active on each item’s decision date.
These corpora differ only for amended and repealed sections. Experiments in § 5.2 supply models with cited text from one corpus or grant access to a retrieval index built over it.
blocks.zh:
我们评价两个法定公司的模型
现行法则反映了2026年9月1日的成文法文本,与传统的基准设置相匹配.
生效令反映了每个项目的决定日期的现行法规。
这些公司只针对修正和废止的章节而有所不同。 第5.2节中的实验提供模型,其中引用了一个实体的文字,或允许查阅该实体之上的检索索引。

blocks.en: 4.4 Release
blocks.zh: 4.4 释放

blocks.en:
The benchmark is released in three parts, defined in § 7.1 .
The validation split, 498 cases, is public. For each case it gives the facts, the questions, the court’s verdict and reasoning, and the gold citations with the version in force on the decision date and the current version, together with the text of those sections in both versions and the grading instruments, the rubric, the judge prompt and the citation-matching rules.
The test split, 500 cases, is held out and is never published, neither its ids nor its text. The leaderboard runs on it, and a model joins the leaderboard when we run it.
The remaining 672 cases are kept in reserve.
The statute corpus, its index, the retrieval service and the harness are not released. A user of the validation split can run the Parametric and Gold-cited In-force settings and not the retrieval settings.
Every released file carries a canary string so that it can be filtered from training corpora.

该基准分三部分发布,定义见第7.1节.
鉴定分出案件498起,公开审理. 对于每个案件,它都提供了事实、问题、法院的判决和推理、黄金引文,连同判决日期和当前版本的版本,以及这两个版本中这些章节的正文和分级工具、标题、法官即时和引用比对规则。

其余672个案件保留在准备金中。
法规、其索引、检索服务以及绳索都没有发布。 验证拆分的用户可以运行参数和被Gold所引用的in-force设置,而不能运行检索设置.
每个被放出的文件都带有金丝雀弦,这样就可以从训练Corpora中过滤出.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: 5.1 Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.1 计量

blocks.en:
We report one score and one diagnostic.
The Bar-standard score is the main metric. It grades the whole answer as a Thai bar examiner would, the verdict, the reasoning and the sections applied.
Citation F1 is a diagnostic of one part of that answer, the statute references. It takes the sections the answer cites and compares them with the sections the court relied on.
The judge reads the answer with its citations, and the citations are therefore already graded inside the Bar-standard score. Citation F1 measures that one part on its own. We do not add the two into one number, because that would count the citations twice.
We show Citation F1 next to the score because the two can move apart, and the gap is informative. The current text of a changed law lowers the score and leaves Citation F1 almost unchanged (§ 6.4 ). A model can cite more sections than the court did and still score in the good tier (§ 7.2 ). Within a model, the citations account for 13 percent of the differences between answers, and the rest is the reasoning (§ 7.6 ).
blocks.zh:
我们报告一个分数和一个诊断。
巴尔标准分是主要的衡量标准. 它将整个答案评为泰国律师审查员、判决、推理和适用章节。
引用F1是对部分答案的诊断,即法规参考. 它将答复所引用的章节与法院所依赖的章节进行比较。
法官用引用来读取答案,因此引用内容已经分到巴尔标准分数内. 引文F1 自行计量。 我们不把两者加到一个数字中,因为这将计算两次引用。
我们在分数旁边显示引文F1,因为两者可以分道扬镳,而差距是信息化的. 目前修改后的法律文本降低了分数,使引用F1几乎保持不变(第6.4节)。 一个模型可以引用比法院多的章节,并且仍然得分处于良好的水平(第7.2节)。 在模型中,引用占答案之间差别的13%,其余部分是推理(第7.6节)。

blocks.en:
The Bar-standard score is the grade of a free-form answer on the official Thai Bar Council grading rubric (Table 6 , Appendix B.1 ). The rubric is the instrument and the score is its result. The rubric combines verdict accuracy with five tiers of reasoning quality.
A matching verdict (T4 to T8) scores from 0 to 10 points.
An incorrect verdict (T1 to T3) is capped at 4 points.
We call the resulting 0 to 10 grade the Bar-standard score.
Following Akarajaradwong et al. [1] , we use a panel of three LLM judges (Claude 4.6 Opus, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and GPT-5.4 Pro) evaluated against human bar examination standards. Each judge receives the verbatim rubric instructions (Appendix B.2 ), and we report the median score across the panel.
blocks.zh:
巴尔标准分是泰国律师理事会官方分级分牌上免费答题的分数(表6,附录B.1.)。 面额为乐器,分数为结果. 标题将判断精度与推理质量的五级结合.
一个匹配的判定(T4到T8)得分从0分到10分.
一个错误的判决(T1到T3)被封顶为4分.
我们称最终的0到10分为"Bar标准分".
追随Akarajaradwong等. [1],我们使用由三位LLM评委组成的小组(Claude 4.6 Opus,双子座3.1 Pro Preview,和GPT-5.4 Pro)根据人类律师资格考试标准评价. 每个法官都收到逐字记录说明(附录B.2),我们报告整个面板的中位分。

blocks.en: Gold citations include all statutory sections required for a sub-question’s verdict. Model citations are resolved to the statute corpus, and background citations mentioned in the ruling are excluded from the predicted set before scoring. We compute Citation F1 per sub-question as the harmonic mean of precision and recall (0 if no sections are cited). Precision and recall breakdowns appear in Table 25 .

blocks.en: Scores are computed hierarchically. Sub-questions are averaged within each item, items are averaged within each domain, and the overall benchmark score is the macro-average across all 17 domains.

blocks.en: We test five experimental configurations across all items: 1. Parametric. The model receives only the question and decision date, testing pretraining recall. 2. Gold-cited Current. The prompt includes the question, decision date, and verbatim text of gold-cited sections on current version. 3. Gold-cited In-force. Identical to Gold-cited Current, but instead uses statutory text active on the decision date, including repealed provisions (serving as the upper bound for perfect retrieval). 4. RAG Current. An agent retrieves sections using a dense index of current statutes via Qwen3-Embedding-8B [ 84 ] , chosen for Thai following SEA-BED [ 68 ] . The tool returns the top 10 matches, and the model controls the tool freely. 5. RAG In-force. Identical to RAG Current, but the evaluation harness filters retrieval candidates by the decision date. The model never selects dates or versions directly, isolating the impact of the retrieved text. The public leaderboard labels Parametric, Gold-cited In-force and RAG In-force as Closed book, Handout and Open book. This report keeps the names above.

blocks.en:
Part I asks whether the version of the text matters.
It follows the benchmark protocol, 13 open-weight models, 1,670 items, three samples per item. It first reports the 13 models in the five settings, the base of every comparison that follows. It then swaps the version of the cited sections, the text in force against the current text, and measures what a model loses when it reads the current text of a law that changed after the decision (§ 3 ). It asks whether a search tool over the law in force gives the loss back, and whether the loss comes from the rule or from the wording. The answer sets the setting that Part II uses.

Table 8 compares the Bar-standard scores of historically accurate text (In-force) against modern text (Current).
The No-drift control group shifts by only 0.01.
In contrast, using the correct historical text improves scores by 0.25 on Amended items and 0.79 on Repealed items.
Every model improves on Repealed items, and every model but Pathumma on Amended items.

The right text occasionally corrects a verdict. Its main benefit is a stronger reasoning behind it.

blocks.en: 7 Part II. The Leaderboard and the Limits of the Open-Weight Models
blocks.zh: 7 第二编. 开放-重量模型的领导板和界限

blocks.en:
Part II measures today’s models on the setting Part I established, the text in force. It follows the leaderboard protocol (§ 5.4 ). Every model runs on the held-out test split of 500 items in three settings, and the public leaderboard page reports the same runs. The page is live and takes new models as we run them. The numbers in this report are the leaderboard as of 2 November 2026.
The page names the settings for a general reader, Closed book for Parametric, Open book for RAG In-force and Handout for Gold-cited In-force. This report keeps the names of § 5.2 . In short, Parametric is the model alone, RAG In-force is the model with a tool that searches the law in force, and Gold-cited In-force is the model with the court’s sections handed to it.
Part II ranks the models (§ 7.2 ), sets the score against its cost (§ 7.3 ), reads the score by domain (§ 7.4 ) and counts invented citations (§ 7.5 ). It ends with what limits the models (§ 7.6 ).
blocks.zh:
第二部分衡量今天的模式,即确定第一部分,即生效的案文。 它遵循领导板协议(§ 5.4). 每个模型都运行在被搁置的测试分出500个物品的3个设置上,公共头板的页面报告相同的运行. 页面是直播的,在运行时采用新模式. 本报告中的数字是截至2026年11月2日的领导牌.
页面为普通读者命名设置,为参数化的封闭书,为RAG In-force的开放书和为Gold所煽动的in-force的发售书. 本报告保留了第5.2节的名称。 简言之,“参数”是唯一的模型,“RAG In-force”是带有搜索现行法律的工具的模型,而“Gold-In-force”是法院交给它的章节的模型。
第二部分对模型进行排序(第7.2节),按成本确定分数(第7.3节),按域阅读分数(第7.4节)并计算发明的引用(第7.5节)。 它的结尾是什么限制了模型(第7.6节)。

blocks.en: 7.1 The test split and the validation split
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 测试拆分和验证拆分

blocks.en: Figure 5 : The three parts of the benchmark. For each domain, the cases in the held-out test split (orange), the released validation split (blue) and the reserve (gray). The label gives the three counts.
blocks.zh: 图5:基准的三个部分。 对于每个域,搁置测试分拆(orange),释放验证分拆(蓝色)和储备(gray)中的案例. 标签给出了三分数.

blocks.en:
A leaderboard has to take in new models as they are released, and a run over all 1,670 items at three samples is too costly to repeat for each one (§ 5.4 ).
A leaderboard also has to stay honest once its questions are public. A model can be trained on a published test set, and its public score then stops meaning anything. GSM1k rebuilt a public arithmetic benchmark in private and found several model families up to 13 percent weaker on the private twin [ 83 ] , and an audit of Chatbot Arena found providers testing dozens of private variants and publishing the best [ 73 ] .
We therefore cut the benchmark into three parts (Figure 5 ). The test split holds 500 items, 29 or 30 from each of the 17 domains, with the drift bands of each domain in the domain’s own proportion and one item per shared-question cluster. The leaderboard runs on it, and it is never published. The validation split is drawn by the same recipe from the remaining items, 498 in all, with no item that shares a question with a test item, and it is released with the text of its gold sections (§ 4.4 ). The 672 items left over are the reserve, which replaces the test split if it ever leaks.
The two splits are drawn to be alike, and the full-benchmark runs of Part I show that they are.
blocks.zh:
排行板在释放时必须采用新的模型,在三个样本中对所有1,670件物品进行抽查费用太高,无法重复(第5.4节)。
一旦问题公开,领导板也必须诚实。 一个模型可以在已公布的测试集上接受训练,其公开得分之后就停止了任何意义. GSM1k重建了私人的公共算术基准,发现几个模范家庭在私人双胞胎上弱到13% [83],对Chatbot Arena的审计发现提供商测试了数十个私人变体并发布了最好的 [73].
因此,我们把基准分成三个部分(图5)。 测试拆分包含500个项目,其中29个或30个来自17个域,每个域的漂移波段按域内自己的比例排列,每个共享问题组有一个项目. 头板在它上运行,它从来没有出版. 验证分出法由同一种配方从所剩物品中抽取出,共498个,没有项目与试件共用一个问题,并随其黄金分出(§ 4.4). 遗留的672件物品是储备品,如果有漏出,该储备品将取代分试.
两分法被划为等分法,而第一部分的全分法标显示它们都是.

blocks.en: 7.3 What the score costs

blocks.en:
An item’s cost is what the answer would have cost to buy. For a model behind an API it is the provider’s list price on 26 October 2026 applied to the measured input, cached and output tokens. For an open-weight model served locally it is the public API price of the same weights applied to the measured tokens, or the price of the base model when the post-training has no public price.
Figure 7 sets the score of each row against that cost in RAG In-force. Table 18 in Appendix D gives the cost, the output length, the searches and the hallucinated citations of each row.
An item costs from a tenth of a cent for the 8B models to 1.155 dollars for Claude Fable 5.1.
GPT-6.1 Sol at 0.134 dollars scores 7.28, at about one ninth of that price.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash scores 6.39 at 0.024 dollars, the price of Claude Haiku 5.5, which scores 4.62.
Writing more does not buy score. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash writes 25.6 thousand tokens per item, DeepSeek V4 Flash 45.4 thousand and Qwen3.8 27B 52.3 thousand. GPT-6.1 Sol writes 4.1 thousand and scores above both.
Searching more does not buy score either. Among the models that search, the calls per item run from 5.3 for Claude Opus 5.5 to 19.0 for DeepSeek V4 Flash, with no relation to rank.

Figure 8 gives the RAG In-force score of every row in every domain.
Averaged over the 26 models, the easiest domain is Natural Resources & Licensing at 4.48 and the hardest is Public Personnel at 3.76.
The three lowest domains are Narcotics, Tax & Revenue and Public Personnel, and the three highest Natural Resources & Licensing, Public Law and Traffic & Transport.

Narcotics is low for a reason of its own. In 69 of its 74 cases the court applied law that has since been repealed, and a model must answer from the text in force and not from what it learned about the current code.

blocks.en: 7.5 Hallucinated citations
blocks.zh: 7.5 迷幻引用

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Hallucinated citations in the Parametric setting. The share of cited sections that do not exist, split into laws that are not in the statute book and real laws cited with a section they do not have.
blocks.zh: 图9:参数设定中的幻觉引用。 所引用的章节中不存在的部分,被分解为没有在法规书中被引用的法律以及没有一节被引用的实际法律.

blocks.en:
A model can cite a section that does not exist. We check every cited section against the statute corpus. A citation is hallucinated when the cited law is not in the corpus, or when the law exists and has no such section.
Citations the corpus cannot decide are left out of the count, and so are references without a section number. The corpus cannot decide an amending act or a ministerial regulation, a royal decree it does not hold, or a section of a repealed law whose text it does not hold. A real instrument the corpus lacks never counts as hallucinated.
The rate is the share of hallucinated citations among the checked citations of a setting.
Figure 9 gives the share of such citations in the Parametric setting, where every citation comes from the model’s memory.
The best models almost never do it. Claude Fable 5.1 invents none of the 6,159 sections it cites and Gemini 4 Argon one of 3,692. Claude Opus 5.5 invents 0.2 percent and GPT-6.1 Terra 0.4 percent.
At the other end, Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B invents 45.9 percent of the sections it cites, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B 42.4 percent, Qwen3-8B 29.0 percent and SEA-LION v4.8 30B-A3B 27.1 percent.
Most invented citations are invented laws. Over the 26 models, 14,906 of the 17,939 hallucinated citations name a law that is not in the statute book, most of them from Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B, and 3,033 name a real law with a section it does not have.
With the search tool (Table 18 ) one thing decides the rate, whether the model searches.
The eight proprietary models are at or near zero, and so are the two open-weight DeepSeek models.
The ThaiLLM 8B models invent 3.0 to 27.6 percent of the sections they cite, Qwen3-8B 25.5 percent and OpenThai 2.0 Legal 24.7 percent. These are the models that never or rarely call the tool (§ 7.6 ).

一个模型可以引用一个不存在的章节. 我们检查每一个引用的章节 与规约。 当援引的法律不在文书中,或者当法律存在并且没有这样的部分时,引用就会产生幻觉。
无法裁定的引用不在计数之外,没有分节号的引用也是如此。 该机构不能决定一项修正法案或一项部级条例、它没有的皇家法令,或它没有案文的被废除法律的一部分。 一个真正的乐器... ... .. ..

图9列出了在参数设定中这种引用的比例,其中每个引用来自模型的记忆。
最好的模特儿几乎从不这样做 Claude Fable 5.1没有发明它引用的6,159个分节,而双子座4 Argon是3,692个分节之一. Claude Opus 5.5发明了0.2%和GPT-6.1 Terra 0.4%。

有了搜索工具(表18),有一件事决定了速率,是否模型搜索.
八种专有模型处于或接近于零,两种开口量的"深网"模型也一样.

blocks.en: 7.6 What limits the models
blocks.zh: 7.6 (中文(简体) ). 是什么限制了模型

blocks.en: Three things can hold a model back on this benchmark, what it knows of the statutes, how it uses the search tool and how it applies the law to the facts. The three settings separate them. Parametric shows what the model knows from memory, RAG In-force what it does with the search tool, and Gold-cited In-force how it applies the court’s sections once it has them. We take them in turn.
blocks.zh: 三事可以牵制这个基准上的模型,它知道什么是章程,它如何使用搜索工具以及它如何将法律应用于事实. 三种设置分别. 参数显示模型从内存中知道什么,RAG In-force显示它用搜索工具做什么,Gold所引用的In-force显示它一旦拥有法院的章节如何应用. 我们轮流处理

blocks.en:
The Parametric setting asks how much Thai law a model knows from training alone. The model gets the question and nothing else, and every section it cites comes from memory.
The proprietary models know a good deal. They score 3.49 to 7.40 and cite the court’s sections with an F1 of 0.28 to 0.58 (Table 17 ).
The open-weight models know little. They score 0.95 to 3.92, and only five of them recall some Thai law, the two DeepSeek models with an F1 of 0.31, Gemma 4 31B 0.30, Gemma 4 26B-A4B 0.27 and Muse Glimmer 0.20.
No other open-weight model reaches 0.15. The ThaiLLM 8B models cite the court’s sections for 2 to 15 percent of sub-questions, and the Thai post-trainings know little more law than their reference models (Table 14 ).
An open-weight model that answers from memory is guessing at the law for most questions.
blocks.zh:
参数设置询问一个模式的泰国法律单从培训中知道多少。 模型得到的问题和没有别的, 它引用的每一节都来自记忆。
专有模型知道一个很好的交易。 他们得分为3.49分至7.40分,并引用了法院F1分为0.28分至0.58分的部分(表17)。
开口量级的模特们知道得很少. 他们得分0.95比3.92 只有五个人记得一些 泰国定律 (Thai Law),由F1为0.31,Gemma为4·31B·0.30,Gemma为4·26B-A4B·0.27和Muse Glimmer为0.20的两款DeepSeek型号.
没有其他的开放重量型号达到0.15. ThaiLLM 8B模型引用了法院的章节中2%至15%的子问题,泰国的后培训所了解的法律几乎不超过参考模型(表14)。
一个从记忆中解答的开放量模型是对大多数问题的法律的猜测.

blocks.en:
The RAG In-force setting gives the model a tool that searches the law in force.
Table 13 shows two numbers for each of the 26 models. The gain is what the tool adds, the RAG In-force score minus the Parametric score. The gap is how far the model still stays below its Gold-cited In-force score, where the court’s sections are given, and it is the most a better search could still add.
For most models the tool helps. Twenty gain, by 0.24 to 2.60 points. Six lose, by 0.08 to 0.31.
The models that search most gain most. DeepSeek V4 Flash makes 19.0 calls per item and gains 1.79 points, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 17.9 calls and 2.60 points, Qwen3.8 27B 17.6 and 2.31, OpenThai 2.0 27B 16.6 and 2.14, and Muse Glimmer 15.8 and 1.58.
The proprietary models gain less, 0.38 to 1.37 points with 5.3 to 9.2 calls per item, because they knew more before they searched.
The six that lose are the four ThaiLLM 8B models, Qwen3-8B and OpenThai 2.0 Legal, and they lose because they do not use the tool. Qwen3-8B, THaLLE, OpenThaiGPT and OpenThai 2.0 Legal never call it. Typhoon-S calls it on one item in three. Pathumma calls it 2.8 times per item and still loses 0.25 points. It retrieves text it cannot use.
For these six models the tool only fills the context. It brings them no law.
The gap is small at the top. For the proprietary models it is 0.07 to 0.74 points, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has closed it, 6.39 as an agent against 6.38 with the sections provided. Every other open-weight model stays 0.48 to 1.52 points below its Gold-cited In-force score.
Even the best agents find the right sections for only part of the questions. With the tool the proprietary models cite the court’s sections with an F1 of 0.51 to 0.66. With the sections provided they reach 0.87 to 0.92.

blocks.en:
The Gold-cited In-force setting gives the model the court’s sections in the prompt. Nothing is left to find, and the score measures one thing, how well the model applies the law it was given to the facts of the case.
With the sections provided the proprietary models score 5.36 to 8.04 and the open-weight models 1.90 to 6.38. Three open-weight models pass 6, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 6.38, DeepSeek V4 Flash at 6.19 and Qwen3.8 27B at 6.04.
The share of answers that reach the court’s verdict shows the same distance. The proprietary models reach it in 72 to 91 percent of their answers, the open-weight models in 39 to 79 percent.
Retrieval does not set this distance. The sections were in the prompt. What remains between the model and a good answer is the reasoning from the statute to the case, and no open-weight model closes it.
blocks.zh:
Gold所引用的“武力”设定让模式的法庭各部分迅速生效。 没有什么可以找到的了, 得分衡量一件事, 模型是如何很好地应用它给 给案件的事实的法律。
由各科提供专有型标分5.36分至8.04分,开放型标分1.90分至6.38分. 3个开口重量型号通过6,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash在6.38,DeepSeek V4 Flash在6.19和Quen3.8 27B在6.04.
到达法庭裁决的答案份额显示同样距离。 专有模型在72%到91%的答案中达到它,开放量模型在39%到79%中达到它.
检索不会设置此距离 。 各节在即. 模式与好答案之间尚存的是从法规到案件的推理,没有开放量级模式可以关闭.

blocks.zh: 图10:由答案引用的"RAG in-Official"F1给出的酒吧标准分. Gray,每个模型一行引用。 黑色,是平均型号,每个型号都以自己的平面为中心. 数字是黑线的上升.

blocks.en:
Figure 10 sorts each model’s answers by their Citation F1 and plots the mean score of each group. Every line rises. On the average model, answers with an F1 of 0.75 or more score 2.2 points above answers that cited none of the court’s sections.
F1 is the one citation number to track. Within a model it follows the score as closely as recall does, a median correlation of 0.34 against 0.35, and more closely than precision, 0.30. Of its two halves, recall carries more weight, 0.28 against 0.11 in a regression with both.
Citing related law beyond the court’s sections costs little. Answers that cite all of the court’s sections and more than as many again still score 0.45 above the model’s mean, and 78 percent of their extra sections are in the same act as one of the court’s.
The gray lines sit about six points apart. The model matters more than its citations.
Citations explain 13 percent of the differences between answers. The rest is the reasoning the rubric grades. With the court’s sections handed to the model, in Gold-cited In-force, the share falls to 5 percent.
The judge sees the citations and the rubric rewards a right one, and part of the link is built in. Even so, the score is not citation matching in disguise. Better citations are worth about two points of ten. The reasoning is worth the rest.
blocks.zh:

F1是用来追踪的一个引用号码. 在模型中,它和召回一样紧跟分数,中相比0.34对0.35,更接近精确度0.30. 在其两个半分中,召回的重量更大,分别为0.28和0.11。
援引法院各科以外的相关法律的费用很少。 引用法院所有部分和更多部分的答案仍然比模型的平均值高0.45分,另外78%的附加部分与法院的相同。
灰色线条相距约6分. 模式的重要性大于引用。
引用解释了13%的答案差异. 其余的就是按标分的推理. 在Gold In-Force案中,
法官认为引用和标题奖励是正确的,部分链接被构建在其中。 即便如此,比分也不是以伪装方式进行引用匹配. 更好的引用值 大约两点十。 推理是值得的 其他的。

blocks.en:
Several Thai groups take an open-weight model and train it further on Thai text or on Thai legal text. The aim is a model that handles Thai law.
Eight such models are on the split, each with a reference model (Table 14 ). For four of them the reference is the base they were trained from. The four ThaiLLM 8B models are post-trainings of ThaiLLM-8B, a Thai continued pretraining of Qwen3-8B-Base that has no chat template and cannot answer the benchmark. Their reference is Qwen3-8B, Alibaba’s own post-training of the same Qwen3-8B-Base, a sibling rather than a parent. That comparison measures the Thai route, continued pretraining on Thai text and then post-training, against Alibaba’s post-training of the same base.
blocks.zh:
几个 泰国团体采用开放量级模式,进一步培训泰国文本或泰国法律文本。 目标是处理泰国法律的模式。
共有8个这种模型处于拆分状态,每个模型都有参考模型(表14)。 对于其中的4人来说,参考标准是他们训练的基地. 4个ThaylLM 8B型是ThaylLM-8B的后期训练,是Qwen3-8B-Base的泰国持续前期训练,没有聊天模板,无法回答基准. 他们的参考文献是Qune3-8B,阿里巴巴自己对同名的Qune3-8B-Base进行后训练,他是一个同父异母兄弟而不是父母. 这一比较衡量了泰国的路线,继续就泰国文字进行预训,然后进行后训练,以对抗阿里巴巴在同一基地进行后训练。

blocks.en:
The extra training taught the models little law.
In the Parametric setting, where a model answers from memory, each post-training scores close to its base.
SEA-LION v4.8 30B-A3B gains the most, 0.51 points over Nemotron 3 Nano, and still cites almost none of the court’s sections from memory, a Citation F1 of 0.04 in that setting (Table 17 ).
OpenThai 2.0 Legal, the one model trained on legal text, scores within 0.03 of its base. OpenThai 2.0 27B scores 0.22 below Qwen3.8 27B. At 8B the Thai route is worth about half a point for two of the four models. Typhoon-S and Pathumma score 0.57 and 0.54 above Qwen3-8B, THaLLE is level with it and OpenThaiGPT is 0.22 below.
blocks.zh:
额外培训教授了模型小法律。
在参数设定中,一个模型从内存中解答,每个训练后得分接近其基数.
SEA-LION v4.8 30B-A3B比Nemotron 3 Nano获得最多,0.51分,但法院几乎没有从记忆中引用过任何部分,在这种背景下引用了0.04分(表17)。
打开泰文 2. 0 法律,一个受过法律文本培训的模型,得分在基数0.03以内。 OpenThai 2.0 27B分出分0.22分低于Qwen3.8 27B. 8 B时,泰国航道对四种车型中的两种车型来说大约值半分. 台风-S和Pathumma的得分为0.57分和0.54分,高于Qune3-8B,THALLE与之并列,OpenThaiGPT为0.22分.

blocks.en:
What the extra training changed in the larger pairs is how the model behaves with the search tool, and in three of the four it changed it for the worse.
SEA-LION v4.8 30B-A3B searches more than its base, 4.7 calls per item against 2.9. It gains 0.83 points in RAG In-force and its Citation F1 rises from 0.25 to 0.34.
SEA-LION v4.8 120B-A12B searches as often as Nemotron 3 Super and scores 0.35 below it. OpenThai 2.0 27B scores 0.38 below Qwen3.8 27B.
OpenThai 2.0 Legal stopped calling the tool. Its base makes 2.9 calls per item and it makes none, and it loses 0.75 points.
Searching the law in force is the one thing that lifts an open-weight model on this benchmark (Table 13 ). Losing it costs more than the training added.
blocks.zh:
附加训练在较大对子中的变化在于模型如何用搜索工具进行行为,在四分之三中,它更是将其改变为更糟糕.
SEA-LION v4.8 30B-A3B搜索比其基地多,每件4.7个呼叫对2.9. 它在RAG in-Official中获得了0.83分,其引文F1从0.25升至0.34.
SEA-LION v4.8 120B-A12B搜索频率与Nemotron 3 Super相同,并得分为下方0.35分. OpenThai 2.0 27B分出分0.38分低于Qwen3.8 27B.
OpenThai 2.0 法律停止调用工具. 它的基数每件发出2.9个呼叫,却不产生任何信号,损失了0.75分.
搜索现行法律是在这一基准上推出一个开放量模型的一件事(表13)。 失去它比培训增加的费用还要多。

blocks.en:
At 8B the base is the limit.
Qwen3-8B and the four ThaiLLM 8B models land within 0.9 points of each other in every setting. None of the five calls the search tool, and the half point that Typhoon-S and Pathumma gain in Parametric is the same half point they gain in RAG In-force.
blocks.zh:
8B时,基数为极限.
Qune3-8B和4个ThaylLM 8B模型在相邻0.9分以内,在每一个相接的场合下相接. 五个都称不上搜索工具,而台风-S和Pathumma在"参数"中获得的半分就是他们在RAG In-force中获得的半分.

blocks.en:
Two things raise an open-weight model on this benchmark, a stronger base and a search tool the model uses.
Across the eight comparisons, training on Thai or legal text added no tool use the reference model lacked and removed it once. It added statute knowledge in two of the four ThaiLLM 8B models, about half a point over Qwen3-8B, and in none of the larger pairs.
Every model ran with its model-card sampling parameters and the same prompt (§ 5.3 ). A post-training tuned for a different prompt style may do better than it does here.
blocks.zh:
有两件事在这个基准上提出了开放量模型,一个更强大的基础和一个模型使用的搜索工具.
在8个比较中,关于泰文或法律文本的培训没有增加任何工具使用缺少的参考模型,并删除过一次。 它在4个ThaylLM 8B模型中的2个中加入了法规知识,相较于Qune3-8B大约半分,在更大型的对子中也没有一个.
每个模型都带有其模型卡抽样参数和同样的快取(第5.3节)。 训练后调用不同的即时风格可能比这里效果更好.

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en:
A benchmark built from dated court decisions and scored against the current law measures two things at once, how well a model reasons and how far the law has moved since the decision.
The second part is large. Half of the 156,650 decisions we audited cite law that has since changed, and in the Supreme Court two in three do (§ 3 ).
It is also easy to miss. The current text rarely flips the verdict. It weakens the reasoning behind a verdict that was right either way (§ 6.2 ). On the items where the Bar-standard score drops by 0.45, Citation F1 moves by 0.04 (§ 6.4 ).
A benchmark that checks the section number or the outcome alone does not see this loss. Its score mixes legal reasoning with statutory drift, in a share that changes every time the legislature sits.
A fair setup records the date of each decision, names the version of each gold citation, stores the text in force next to the current text, and releases the full versioned corpus. Without the corpus nobody can repeat the experiments or audit the gold answers. Without the dates a benchmark goes stale and nobody notices, as NitiBench shows two years after release (§ 3 ).
Every result of Part II is measured on this setup. Of the 53 legal benchmarks we audited, none meets it (§ 3 ).
blocks.zh:
根据过时的法院裁决制定的基准,对照现行法律,衡量两件事情,示范理由如何,以及自裁决以来法律进展多快。
第二部分为大. 我们所审计的156,650个裁决中有一半援引了此后已经改变的法律,最高法院有三分之二引用了法律(第3节)。
也很容易错过。 目前的案文很少翻转判决. 它削弱了无论哪种方式都是正确的判决背后的理由(第6.2节)。 关于巴尔标准分数下降0.45分的项目,引用F1移动了0.04(§ 6.4).
仅检查段号或结果的基准并不反映这一损失。 其得分将法律推理与法定漂移相混合,其份额每逢立法机构开会时都会有变化.
一个公平的设置记录了每个决定的日期,命名了每个被引用金字的版本,将当前文本旁边的生效文本存储起来,并发布完整版本的正文. 没有尸体 没有人可以重复实验 或审计黄金答案。 如Niti Bench在释放两年后(第3节)所示,
第二部分的每个结果都在这个设置上进行测量. 在我们审计的53个法律基准中,没有一项达到(第3节)。

blocks.en:
Searching the current law is the wrong default for a dispute rooted in a past event.
Missing repealed law costs three times more than reading amended law, 0.79 against 0.25 points. Repealed provisions must stay in the index.
The date filter belongs in the retrieval layer rather than in the prompt. A search over the law in force recovers 0.11 points on amended law and 0.47 on repealed law for the models that search, and nothing for the models that do not (§ 6.3 ).
The strongest models gain the most from the text in force, up to 0.45 points on amended law and 1.35 on repealed law, because they build their answer on the text they are given. As models improve, the penalty for the wrong version grows.
blocks.zh:
搜索现行法律是对根植于过去事件的纠纷的错误默认.
缺失被废除的法律比阅读修正后的法律花费多出三倍,0.79比0.25分. 废止的规定必须保留在索引中。
日期过滤器属于取回层,而不属于快取层. 对现行法律进行搜索后,对已修订的法律收回了0.11分,对已废除的法律收回了0.47分,对搜索模式则收回了0.37分,对未搜索模式则收回了0.36分(第6.3节)。
最强的模型从生效的文本中获得最多,修正后的法律最多可得到0.45分,被废除的法律最多可得到1.35分,因为它们在给出的文本上建立了答案. 随着模型的改进,对错误版本的惩罚会增加.

blocks.en:
The best proprietary models score 7.0 to 7.8 on the leaderboard with the search tool, and Claude Fable 5.1 scores 7.4 from memory alone. On the Bar Council scale this is the good tier.
These models know the Thai statutes, they search, and they stay within half a point of their own ceiling.
They cite more sections than the court did, a precision of 0.39 to 0.61 against a recall of 0.69 to 0.88 (§ 7.2 ).
The best open-weight model, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, scores 6.39, 1.4 points below Claude Fable 5.1, at 0.02 dollars per answer (§ 7.3 ).
The 13 open-weight models of the benchmark protocol stop at 4.94 with the search tool and 5.75 with the court’s sections in the prompt, the acceptable tier.
Two things stand between them and a good answer. The first is finding the law. The in-force index returns the court’s sections for 48 percent of the searches (§ 6.3 ). The second is applying it. With the right sections in hand no model passes 6, and about six answers in ten reach the court’s verdict (Table 10 ).
blocks.zh:
拥有搜索工具的领跑板上最佳专有模式得分为7.0至7.8分,而克洛德·菲克5.1单从内存中得分为7.4分. 在律师公会规模上,这是很好的层级。
这些模型知道泰国的法规,它们搜索,它们停留在自己上限的半分之内.
他们引用的章节比法院多,精确度为0.39至0.61,而召回的是0.69至0.88(第7.2节)。
最好的开放量级模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash),得分6.39分,低于克洛德·菲克5.1的1.4分,每答0.02美元(§ 7.3.
基准协议的13个开放重量模式在4.94与搜索工具相接,在5.75与法院各部分相接,处于可接受的水平。
有两件事站在他们中间 一个好的答案。 第一种是找到法律。 生效指数将法院部分的搜索比例回回为48%(第6.3节)。 第二是应用. 拥有正确的部分,没有模型通过6个,大约每10个答复中有6个得到法院的判决(表10)。

blocks.en:
The 26 models split into those that use the search tool and those that do not.
The twenty that use it gain 0.24 to 2.60 points. The six that do not lose points.
Four of the six never call the tool. Two call it and cannot use what it returns.
A Thai legal system built on a model that does not search can only know what the model remembers. The Parametric column of Table 13 shows how little that is for every open-weight model but the two DeepSeek models, Gemma 4 and Muse Glimmer.
Tool use comes first for Thai legal QA, before Thai data and before legal data.
blocks.zh:
26个模型分为使用搜索工具的模型和不使用搜索工具的模型.
使用它的20个得到0.24到2.60分. 六者不减分相.
六者有四从不唤作工具. 二唤作而不能用所回所回.
A级 泰国法律制度建立在不搜索的模型上,只能知道模型记忆中的内容. 表13的参数栏显示,对于每个开放量级模型来说,只有Gemma 4和Muse Glimer这两个DeepSeek模型是很少的。
泰国法律质量保证首先使用工具,先使用泰国数据,再使用法律数据。

blocks.en:
Training an open-weight model further on Thai or legal text is the main route Thai groups take to a Thai legal model.
On NitiBench + it added little law, about half a point in two of the four ThaiLLM 8B models over Qwen3-8B, which shares their base, and nothing in the larger pairs. In RAG In-force it raised one of the larger bases and lowered three, and in one pair the model stopped using the tool (§ 7.6 ).
Qwen3-8B and the four ThaiLLM 8B models land within 0.9 points of each other, and none of the five searches.
The gains on this benchmark come from a stronger base and from searching the law in force.
The open problem is a post-training that keeps the tool use of the base and teaches the model to apply the statutes to the facts. The benchmark measures both.
blocks.zh:
主要途径是在泰文或法律文本方面进一步培训一个开放式模式 泰国团体采用泰国法律模式。
在Niti Bench +上,它添加了"小定律",在四个ThaylLM 8B模型中的两个模型中大约有半分,比起分享其基数的Qune3-8B,在更大的一对模型中则没有. 在RAG In-Force中,它提升了一个更大的基地并降低了三个基地,一对模型停止使用该工具(第7.6节)。
Qune3-8B和4个ThaylLM 8B模型相接相接0.9分以内着陆,5个搜索中均无.
这一基准的收益来自更强大的基础和对现行法律的搜索。
开放问题在于训练后,保留了基底的工具使用,并教导模型将章程应用于事实. 基准衡量两者。

blocks.en:
Over the 27 leaderboard rows the mean score runs from 4.49 in Natural Resources & Licensing to 3.76 in Public Personnel. The five lowest domains are Public Personnel, Administrative Contracts, Tax & Revenue, Narcotics and Criminal (§ 7.4 ).
Two of the five are domains of the Supreme Administrative Court. Its cases cite acts, decrees and regulations outside the codes, and each of these has its own history of amendment and repeal.
A model trained on the codes alone is not a model of Thai law.
The per-domain scores are the numbers a user should read, and Appendix E.1 gives them for every model.
blocks.zh:
在27个排行中,平均得分从自然资源和许可证4.49分到公务员3.76分。 五个最低的领域是公共人事、行政合同、税收和收入、麻醉品和刑事(第7.4节)。
五个领域中有两个是最高行政法院的领域。 其案例援引了法典以外的法令、法令和条例,其中每一项都有自己的修正和废除历史。
仅受过有关守则培训的范本不是泰国法律的范本。
每个域的分数是用户应该读取的数字,附录E.1给出每个模型的数字.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: NitiBench + measures Thai legal question answering the way a Thai court and a Thai bar examiner would. The questions come from decided cases, the grade covers the verdict and the reasoning, and the sections the court relied on are read in the version in force on the day of the decision.
blocks.zh: Niti Bench + 措施 泰国的法律问题回答了泰国法院和泰国律师审查员的处理方式。 问题出自已判决的案件,等级涵盖判决和推理,法院所依赖的部分在判决当天生效的版本中被读取.

blocks.en:
Part I shows that the version of the text is part of the task.
Half of 156,650 Thai decisions cite law that has since changed.
When a model reads the current text of a changed law, its Bar-standard score falls. This holds for every model, and verdict agreement and Citation F1 barely move.
A legal benchmark must therefore record the date of each question, name the version of the law in force on that date, and grade against that text. A deployed system must index the law by date and keep repealed provisions.
The text in force is the fair setting, and it is the setting of the leaderboard.
blocks.zh:
第一部分显示文本的版本是任务的一部分.
156 650人的一半 泰国的裁决援引了后来改变的法律。
当一个模型读取了修改后的法律的当前文本时,它的巴-标准分数会下降. 这对每个模型都有利,判决协议和引用F1几乎不动。
因此,一个法律基准必须记录每个问题的日期,列出该日生效的法律文本,并对照该文本进行分级。 部署的系统必须按日期编制法律索引,并保留被废除的规定。
生效的文本是公平的设置,也是领导板的设置.

blocks.en:
Part II measures today’s models on that setting.
The best proprietary model is graded good.
The best open-weight model of the benchmark protocol is graded acceptable, and no open-weight model reaches the good tier.
With no text in front of them, the open-weight models know almost no Thai law. The two DeepSeek Flash models, Gemma 4 and Muse Glimmer are the exceptions.
A search tool over the law in force closes part of the distance for the models that use it, and none for the models that do not.
The court’s sections in the prompt close more. What remains is the application of the law to the facts.
The administrative domains are the hardest. Training on Thai or legal data added about half a point of law knowledge in two of the four ThaiLLM 8B models, against Alibaba’s post-training of the same base, and none in the three larger pairs we can test.
The leaderboard takes new models as they are released, on the same setup. Its test split is held out, and a validation split of the same shape is public.
blocks.zh:
第二部分衡量今天在这方面的模式。
最佳专有模式评分良好.
基准协议的最佳开放量级模型是可接受分级的,没有开放量级模型达到好分级.
在他们面前没有文字,开放量级的模特们几乎不知道泰国的法律. 两个DeepSeek Flash模型,Gemma 4和Muse Glimer都是例外.
一个凌驾于现行法律之上的搜索工具关闭了使用该工具的模型的部分距离,而对于没有使用该工具的模型则没有。
法院各科在迅速关闭。 剩下的是法律对事实的适用。
行政领域最为困难。 关于泰国或法律数据的培训在泰国的4个LM 8B模型中的2个模型中增加了大约一半的法律知识,与阿里巴巴在同一基地的后训练相比,我们无法测试三个更大的对。
领跑板在发布时采用新的模式,在相同的设置上. 其测试分出被坚持,同形状的验证分出被公开.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
NitiBench + covers Thai law and follows Thai legal practice. To repeat the method in another jurisdiction, one needs the statute text as it stood on each date and a corpus of dated decisions.
The benchmark samples from three high courts. It leaves out military courts, lower courts, and advisory rulings from government agencies.
The 17 domains hold between 56 and 146 items each. The macro-average weights them equally.
blocks.zh:
Niti Bench + 覆盖 泰国法律及以下 泰国法律实践。 为了在另一个法域重复这一方法,需要每个日期的现有规约文本和一系列已过时的决定。
三个高等法院的基准样本。 它不包括军事法院、下级法院和政府机构的咨询裁决。
17个域各有56至146项。 宏观平均加权均匀。

blocks.en:
An LLM judge scores the reasoning.
Its agreement with human bar examination graders was checked in earlier work [ 1 ] . A judge model cannot fully replace a human expert, least of all on a fine or borderline point of law.
blocks.zh:
LLM评委评比推理.
其与人大律师考试分级员的协议在更早的工作[1]被检查. 法官模式不能完全取代人类专家,尤其是在精细或边缘法律方面。

blocks.en:
The benchmark protocol holds 13 open-weight models of 8B to 120B parameters, served locally.
The leaderboard adds eight proprietary models and five further open-weight models on the 500-item split, with one sample per item for every row outside the 13 and Qwen3-8B. A single sample carries the sampling noise shown in Table 23 .
Every model runs with the sampling parameters of its model card and the same prompt. A prompt or an agent loop tuned to one model can move its score.
The test split is held out, so a model appears on the leaderboard when we run it and not when its maker does.
blocks.zh:
基准协议持有13个8B到120B参数的开放重量模型,在当地使用.
领跑板在500个项目分拆上增加了8个专有模型和5个再开放重量模型,13和Qwen3-8B以外的每行每条项目都有一个样本. 单一样本带有表23所示的取样噪音。
每个模型都带有其模型卡的采样参数和同样的快取. 快速或代理循环调取到一个模型可以移动它的分数.
测试拆分被坚持,所以当我们运行时,而不是当它的制造者运行时,一个模型会出现在领导板上.

blocks.en:
The version effects are modest.
Reading the current text of amended law costs about 0.25 points of the Bar-standard score on its 10-point scale, and missing repealed law costs about 0.8 points.
Seeing any legal text at all matters more. It adds 0.8 to 2.4 points across models.
blocks.zh:
版本效果是适度的.
读取目前修改后的法律文本,其10分的巴尔标准分数成本约为0.25分,而缺失被废除的法律成本约为0.8分.
见一切法正法正相更相. 它在跨模型中增加了0.8到2.4分.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
All rulings and decisions used are publicly available government documents.
Under Section 7(2) to (5) of Thailand’s Copyright Act B.E. 2537 (1994), government documents are explicitly excluded from copyright protection and reside in the public domain.
NitiBench + is intended for research evaluation and is not a substitute for professional legal advice.
blocks.zh:
所有使用的裁决和决定都是公开的政府文件。
根据泰国《版权法》B.E. 2537(1994)第7(2)至(5)条,政府文件被明确排除在版权保护之外,并属于公共领域。
Niti Bench + 用于研究评价,不能替代专业法律咨询.

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集

blocks.en: A.1 Released files and dataset example
blocks.zh: A.1 已发布文件和数据集实例

The example that follows is a case of the validation split, the item of Figure 1 .

Fact pattern (Thai, translated): A voluntarily insured person under the Social Security Act B.E. 2533 died of causes unrelated to work. She had no spouse and no children, her parents had died before her, and she had named no beneficiary. Her full sister claimed the death grant and the old-age lump sum. The Social Security Office refused both, and the appeal committee upheld the refusals. The sister sued, arguing that the contributions were savings that passed to her as a statutory heir. The Central Labour Court upheld the refusal of the death grant. It held that the old-age lump sum was part of the estate and passed to the statutory heirs. Both parties appealed. Sub-question 2 (contrast with the lower court): The Central Labour Court held that the right of a deceased insured person to the old-age lump sum passes to the statutory heirs under the Civil and Commercial Code, and that the full sister may therefore claim it. Was that correct, and why? Gold verdict : No. The sister is not among the heirs that section 77 quater, paragraph two, entitles to the lump sum. Even when none of those heirs exists, money of the Social Security Fund cannot be paid to other heirs against sections 24 and 77 quater. Gold citations : Social Security Act B.E. 2533, sections 77 quater, 77(2), and 24 paragraph one, all relied on. Section 77 bis is kept as background. Section 77 quater . In force on the decision date : version_uri .../v/2002-10-09 , valid 2002-10-09 to 2015-10-19. Current : current_uri .../v/2023-10-25 , drift amended . Both texts are in gold_sections.jsonl . The current text adds a paragraph that gives the lump sum to full siblings first when no heir of paragraph two exists.

blocks.zh: A.2 漂流带

blocks.en: Each gold citation is resolved to two versions of its section in the dated section corpus. One is the version in force on the decision date. The other is the current version, the one in force on 1 September 2026 in a law that is still active. A citation is repealed when its law is no longer active or the section no longer exists. It is amended when the two versions have different content hashes, and unchanged otherwise. An item takes the most severe state among the citations its verdicts rely on, with repealed above amended above unchanged. Background citations do not set the band. The Repealed band also holds the few citations to a law that was already repealed on the decision date, because a court applies the law in force when the facts occurred (Penal Code §2–3 set this rule for criminal matters). Such citations are rare. They are not drift, since the text did not change after the decision, but for a retriever over current law the text is missing all the same.

blocks.en: Citation scores are computed in two stages. Resolution maps each predicted citation to a section identifier in the corpus. Matching compares the resolved set with the gold set of the sub-question (§ 5.1 ).

blocks.en: 1. Resolution. In every setting except Parametric the model copies a version identifier from the text it was given or retrieved. The scorer looks the identifier up in the dated section corpus and takes that version’s section. In Parametric the model names a law and a section, or gives the section identifier. A law name is resolved against the law catalog of the corpus with rapidfuzz.WRatio (threshold 85). The section label is normalized (Thai numerals to Arabic digits, sub-paragraph markers removed). The section is then resolved to its version in force on the decision date. 2. Matching. Citation F1 counts a match when the section identifiers agree. A predicted section that the sub-question’s source cites only as background is removed from the prediction set first, so it is neither a hit nor a false positive. 3. Aggregation. Precision, recall, and F1 are computed per sub-question, averaged within an item, averaged within a domain, and then macro-averaged over the seventeen domains.
